motivation: The completed Lepidoptera primary analysis found no positive gradient for composite ecological similarity, and post-primary exploratory prediction showed that wing-size similarity, host-breadth similarity, voltinism similarity and habitat similarity do not individually improve held-out pair prediction. Host breadth does not measure the geographic distribution of larval resources. This follow-up prospectively tests host-resource geography on a fully species-disjoint panel.
scientific_question: Do Lepidoptera species that experience more similar larval host-resource geography show more congruent post-IBD spatial genetic structure, and does adult dispersal capacity modify that relationship?

biological_rationale.adult_axis: Wing size is a predeclared proxy for adult dispersal capacity.
biological_rationale.larval_axis: Larvae are tied to host resources; the realized geographic availability of host plants can constrain connectivity through a route distinct from adult movement capacity.
biological_rationale.critical_boundary: The mechanism 'host-resource geography constrains gene flow' is a hypothesis to be tested, not a conclusion imported from the completed study.

independent_species_domain.rule: A species used in either prior empirical-design universe is permanently excluded even if it later failed a character-mask gate. No species may contribute to both the completed study and this confirmatory follow-up.

external_host_data.dataset: HOSTS - a Database of the World's Lepidopteran Hostplants
external_host_data.primary_host_taxon_level: host plant species only: non-empty Hostplant Genus + Hostplant Species
exclude_from_primary: records lacking a resolvable host plant species
external_host_data.host_record_location: retained for descriptive/sensitivity use only; not the primary host-resource distribution surface

plant_distribution_data.dataset: World Checklist of Vascular Plants / Plants of the World Online distribution backbone
plant_distribution_data.taxonomy_normalization: Host plant names are normalized against the frozen WCVP name backbone before any insect genetic response is opened.

host_resource_footprint.per_insect_species: Union of native WGSRPD level-3 units occupied by all species-level larval host plants recorded for that insect in the frozen HOSTS source.
host_resource_footprint.host_weighting_primary: equal weight per distinct host plant species before union; duplicate interaction records do not increase geographic weight
host_resource_footprint.primary_pair_similarity: Jaccard similarity between source and target host-resource WGSRPD-unit sets
secondary_descriptors_response_blind: number of distinct host plant species
fraction of host taxa successfully matched to WCVP

adult_dispersal_axis.similarity: exp(-absolute difference in panel-standardized log1p wing-size proxy)
adult_dispersal_axis.role: predeclared adult-mobility predictor distinct from host-resource geography

primary.name: host_resource_geography_similarity_gradient
primary.response: pairwise congruence of the same endpoint-safe post-IBD edge response used by the completed genetic framework
primary.geometry_control: unchanged response-blind pair geometry covariates from v0.2: target-to-source coverage, centroid distance, edge-count ratio, locality-count ratio and geometry-kernel similarity

secondary_predeclared.adult_wing_similarity: increment of wing-size similarity beyond geometry
secondary_predeclared.joint_constraint: increment of host-resource geography similarity x wing-size similarity beyond both main effects and geometry
secondary_predeclared.interpretation: tests whether matching both larval resource geography and adult dispersal capacity identifies pairs with greater spatial-genetic congruence

response_blind_census_gate.if_fail: STOP before character masks or new nucleotide identity; redesign requires a new protocol version.

future_synthetic_qualification.rule: Synthetic amplitudes, nuisance reference family, seed namespaces and qualification thresholds must be frozen only after the response-blind census passes and before character masks or nucleotide identity are opened.

stopping_rules: Do not use the completed 240-species empirical pairwise outcomes to tune the host-resource predictor, host-plant matching rule, WCVP footprint rule or census thresholds.
Do not relax species-level host identification to genus/family after seeing census or response results under this version.
Do not include introduced WCVP plant ranges in the primary footprint after seeing outcomes.
Do not open new-panel nucleotide identity until the host-geography census, character-mask gate and exact-survivor synthetic qualification all pass.
Any failed confirmatory gate yields NOT_EVALUABLE, not evidence against the host-resource mechanism.
